title: LED Inspection - Scratches Detection on Archer 750
subtitle: Pre-Diffusion Quality Validation for 45nm Node Manufacturing
author: Lisa Johansson

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Archer 750 system to detect and classify Scratches defects during pre-diffusion inspection at the 45nm technology node. The test is conducted at Hsinchu Fab 15 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Scratches defects that are critical to yield at the 45nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Archer 750 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Archer 750
- Inspection Type: LED Inspection
- Target Defect: Scratches
- Process Step: Pre-Diffusion
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 45nm
- Fab Location: Hsinchu Fab 15

This test case applies to all Archer 750 systems deployed at Hsinchu Fab 15 for pre-diffusion monitoring in the 45nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Archer 750
Software Version: v15.8.203
Recipe: LED_INSPECTION_45nm_PRE_DIFFUSION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: High (129 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.1μm
Edge Exclusion: 2mm
Sampling Plan: 9-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Archer 750 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'LED Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Scratches defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 45nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 118 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 95% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.1% for LED Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.93 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-09-24
Wafers Tested: 39
Total Defects Found: 776
Defect Density: 247.01 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 5.1%
Capture Rate: 88.7%
Test Duration: 391 minutes
System Uptime: 99.2%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Archer 750 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Scratches at the 45nm node.

b) The capture rate requires optimization of the detection algorithm.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Throughput metrics met production requirements without sensitivity compromise.

e) Statistical process control charts showed stable performance over the test period.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
